messages:
Carmen: FYI I pushed a quick dashboard PR that wires per-route token-level waterfall metrics into the SLO page. Saw a tail jump after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak.
Alek: saw that — p95 for /chat/generate went 120ms -> 210ms starting ~1920420000. Did kernel-selector change land in canary?
SRE-bot: Deploy 1920417000 by alek — canary rollout (20%) -> success.
Ji-ho: I profiled an hour around the spike: kernel switch changed default packing for small batches; observed more kernel handoffs and KV cache thrash.
Rachel: kv-cache hit-rate on that route dropped from 87% to 61% during the window. That matches extra KV lookups we see in logs.
Alek: interesting — do we have histogram of batch_shape -> kernel mapping? I want to confirm smallbatch->slow-kernel correlation.
Carmen: added a temporary metric: runtime_kernel_handoff_total{kernel="pack_small"} and batch_shape_histogram per-route. Query in dashboard: sum(rate(runtime_kernel_handoff_total[5m])) by (route,kernel)
Max: can you paste the PromQL? Also need token-level breakdown (decode, kv_lookup, kernel_exec, postproc).
Carmen: PromQL snippets I used:
```
sum by(route, le) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (route, le)))
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (route)
sum(rate(runtime_kernel_handoff_total[5m])) by (route, kernel)
```
Ji-ho: I captured a flame sample: sequences with batch_size<=3 are routed to pack_small kernel which has 2x per-token exec time for short sequences vs pack_large. Kernel selector fallback logic prefers latency-safe kernels — our change inverted that for small batches.
Rachel: Ops note: we saw a small increase in scheduler queue_wait (median +10ms, p99 +65ms). Might be due to increased processing time per token on pack_small.
Alek: Proposed mitigations: 1) revert the selector flip for canary, 2) add a routing experiment metric (route->kernel assignment ratio), 3) surface kv-cache hit by prefix so we can correlate.
Carmen: I've opened an issue with perf repro + dashboards and linked traces: https://go/internal/issue/RI-6421. I also added a heatmap tile: batch_size vs queue_wait vs kernel.
SRE-bot: Incident check: no customer-facing errors; alerting thresholds tripped for route /chat/generate p99 latency > 300ms (3m).
Max: I'll run microbench with synthetic small batches across kernels and attach numbers here by EOD.
Rachel: For dashboards, please include: per-route token breakdown, kernel_assignment_ratio (by route), kv_cache_hit_rate_by_prefix, and batch_shape_heatmap. Keep 1m and 5m rolling windows.
Alek: Agree. After Max's microbench, we can either revert or change selector threshold to prefer pack_large when batch_size<=4.
Carmen: thanks — rolling back canary now and leaving the dashboard tiles so we can watch. Revert PR: https://go/internal/pr/4132
Max: microbench results: pack_small p50=6ms/token p99=18ms/token, pack_large p50=3ms/token p99=9ms/token for seq_len<=32. Will drop full logs in the issue.
Ji-ho: given those numbers, selector revert makes sense. Also adding an experiment tag to requests to measure A/B impact.
Carmen: noted. I'll keep the dashboard pinned and iterate on instrumentation (add per-kernel token buckets and kv miss reason).
Rachel: thanks all — notify if rollback doesn't restore pre-change tail within 30m. :thumbsup:
